text:
sam: support popped a ticket; a few users hit 401s after rotation and the SDKs retried for ~30s before surfacing the error, which confused them during onboarding.

mina: looked at logs  the client shows repeated 401s then a single generic error. SDK retry/backoff currently hides the immediate 401 cause.

jun: retrying is good for transient infra errors but bad for auth failures. we should stop retries on 401s and surface a clear, actionable message instead.

tia: agreed. also discovered a messy env-var situation: docs, quickstarts, and a legacy internal guide use three different names (REDWOOD_API_KEY / REDWOOD_KEY / REDWOOD_TOKEN). new users copy-paste the wrong one.

sam: proposal: SDKs accept resolution order REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_KEY > REDWOOD_TOKEN. If KEY or TOKEN used, emit a one-line deprecation warning. Also, if an auth failure occurs, SDK should immediately return an enriched error: "401 Unauthorized: likely causes: rotated key, project-scoped key, or wrong env var name. Run `rw auth export` for shell export lines or `rw auth export --ps1` for PowerShell."

mina: +1. let's also add a specific error code/subclass on the API (e.g., 401.2 "rotation-suspected") when the presented key matches a legacy prefix pattern. That will let SDKs short-circuit retries and UIs render targeted help.

jun: for local dev, Windows users kept failing because our docs only show bash/zsh export. let's add PowerShell and Windows CMD snippets to sampleapp README and the CLI helper. Example: PowerShell: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "rw_..."` and CMD: `set REDWOOD_API_KEY=rw_...`

tia: support suggested adding a tiny CLI helper `rw auth export --format {bash,ps1,cmd}` that prints the right commands. low-risk and massively helpful.

sam: I'll own SDK changes: stop retrying on 401, add richer error mapping, accept env fallbacks, and emit deprecation warnings. Mina, can you add server-side tagging: when a presented key matches legacy prefix or recently-rotated prefix, attach `rotation-suspected` and include rotation timestamp if available?

mina: yes. I'll also emit a metric for "401_no_retry" events so support can see how many runs hit this condition.

jun: sampleapp/update: I'll patch the README to include full env examples for bash, ps1, and cmd, plus a short troubleshooting block. Also include a small script `scripts/rehydrate-env` that prints platform-appropriate export commands.

tia: don't forget to add a short support triage note: 1) verify env var name, 2) check key scope (org vs project), 3) try `rw auth export --format bash`, 4) if still 401, regenerate an org-scoped key and re-run.

sam: timeline: SDK PRs by EOD, sampleapp + CLI helper PRs tomorrow morning. We'll tag the support ticket with PR links.

ops-bot: rotation-log: customer rotated key at 2025-10-03T04:17:20Z; old_prefix=rw_leg987; new_prefix=rw_new123; affected_clients=5

tia: thanks all. these fixes (stop-401-retries + env parity + CLI export + better 401 subclassing) should reduce confused-onboarding tickets a lot. :thumbsup:
